# Nexus Ways Group

> Nexus Ways Group is a boutique business advisory and investment firm that helps B2B, SaaS and AI companies become investable, scalable and internationally expandable, and connects vetted businesses with investors. It operates from Istanbul and Dubai and serves clients and investors across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Europe and the Middle East. Nexus Ways is not an investment fund and does not manage capital.

Nexus Ways Group works with a limited number of clients and delivers advisory work as fixed-fee, project-based engagements. Investment engagements are bespoke.

## Solutions

- [Business Strategy](https://nexus-ways.com/solutions/business-strategy/): Core advisory practice covering business planning, strategy, financial modeling, fundraising readiness, go-to-market strategy and growth roadmaps.
- [Fundraising](https://nexus-ways.com/solutions/business-strategy/fundraising/): Fundraising readiness, investor materials, pitch narrative and financial models for companies preparing to raise capital.
- [Business Growth](https://nexus-ways.com/solutions/business-strategy/business-growth/): Go-to-market strategy, sales and pricing strategy, and growth roadmaps for B2B companies.
- [Market Entry](https://nexus-ways.com/solutions/business-strategy/market-entry/): Market entry and international expansion advisory.
- [Digital Engine](https://nexus-ways.com/solutions/digital-engine/): Execution arm supporting advisory clients: SEO, paid media, websites, content and AI infrastructure, each independently scoped and measured against targets agreed in writing.
- [SEO](https://nexus-ways.com/solutions/digital-engine/seo/): Technical SEO audit and roadmap, monthly SEO execution, and local search and authority building.
- [Paid Ads](https://nexus-ways.com/solutions/digital-engine/ads/): Google, Meta and LinkedIn campaigns managed against return, with tracking before spend and ad budgets kept in the client's own accounts.
- [Website](https://nexus-ways.com/solutions/digital-engine/website/): Conversion-focused corporate websites and e-commerce stores, mobile-first and fully tracked, with the domain registered to the client.
- [Content](https://nexus-ways.com/solutions/digital-engine/content/): Editorial content and social media across LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube, built on a brand tone guide and a value-first content mix.
- [AI Infrastructure](https://nexus-ways.com/solutions/digital-engine/ai-infrastructure/): CRM implementation, workflow and lead automation, and AI-assisted content and reporting with human review.
- [Investment Arm](https://nexus-ways.com/solutions/investment-arm/): Investor deal flow, startup and business screening, commercial and strategic due diligence, investor matching and introductions, and deal structuring support for angels, family offices, VC funds and corporate investors.
- [Nexus Desk](https://nexus-ways.com/#desk): Investment intelligence product from the Investment Arm for discovering, evaluating and comparing opportunities, starting with real estate in Istanbul, Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Research and analysis only, not investment advice.
- [Nexus Desk — Markets](https://nexus-ways.com/desk/markets/): Market coverage, evidence standards and market-specific gates for Istanbul, Dubai and Abu Dhabi. No market figures, prices or returns are published.
- [Nexus Desk — How we evaluate](https://nexus-ways.com/desk/intelligence/): The evidence, analytical methods (with their current availability) and controls behind Nexus Desk, and what each output does not claim.

## Languages

Every page is available in English, Turkish (`/tr/…`) and Arabic (`/ar/…`); Nexus Desk under `/desk/`, `/desk/tr/` and `/desk/ar/`.

## Focus

- Industries: B2B SaaS, AI, enterprise software, PropTech, FinTech, e-commerce, logistics, supply chain, ClimateTech, deep tech, real estate.
- Regions: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, Middle East; operating bases in Istanbul and Dubai.
- Audiences: founders and executives of B2B companies; angel investors, family offices, VC funds and corporate investors.
